description:
Generic description of whatever implementation handled a stage.

The pipeline graph never knows concrete vendor names — it only knows
capabilities (e.g. "voice_provider"). This descriptor is where the
concrete provider identity is recorded, for telemetry/debugging, without
leaking that identity into the graph or contracts.

model.description: Underlying model name used by the provider implementation.
model.title: Model

version.description: Version/tag of the model or provider implementation.
version.title: Version

capability.description: The abstract capability this provider fulfills, e.g. 'script_generation', 'voice_synthesis', 'avatar_render'.
capability.title: Capability

endpoint.description: Provider API endpoint or resource identifier, if applicable
endpoint.title: Endpoint

cost.description: Cost incurred for this stage execution, if known
cost.title: Cost

latency_ms.description: Execution latency in milliseconds, if known
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

timestamp.description: When this provider was invoked, if known
timestamp.title: Timestamp

title: ProviderDescriptorV1
